234237.note: The lidar relief shows a building-sized gap in the ground returns right at the pin, and the photo a gray roof edge just north of it under the autumn canopy, so the pin reads as the cabin. No road or trail shows near it in the photo or either layer. Nothing traced.

234238.note: The pin sits on the cabin's roof, which shows in a small opening in the spruce; no drawn road or trail reaches it (an old track shows 150 m northwest).

234241.note: The cabin shows in a clearing 25 m northeast of the pin, beside the highway; traced its gravel driveway from the highway (checked over the photo). The pin sits in the trees west of the cabin, close enough to find it but not on it.

234476.note: The pin sits at the edge of a mown clearing in the forest that is plainly the group site; no drawn road reaches it in the zoomed frame.

234681.note: The lidar layers show Farnsworth Road plainly beside the pin and a gravel area with a lane running north-east from it 15 m south-east of the pin, but no building-shaped gap in the ground returns: the two raised blobs in the relief 15 to 30 m east read as mounds, and the photo shows only a small brown patch under the trees there. The cabin can't be placed. Nothing traced.

261322.note: The pin sits on the house, and the drawn farm lane passes 25 m southwest with a walk up to the door.

10004657.note: The pin sits on the house; traced its paved drive from the bend in the drawn road (checked over the photo).

10004661.note: Zoomed in, what read as a bare sandy patch is a brown-roofed house, and the pin is already at its north edge, at the listing's own point; the drawn sand road passes 15 m south of it.

10004663.note: The pin sits on the house roof, and the drawn sand lane runs past it 15 m east, with the drive between them.

10004667.note: The pin sits on the house roof, beside its drive off the drawn sand lane.

10045243.note: The pin sits on the long motel building beside the drawn highway, with its parking lot between them.

10045245.note: The pin sits on the long motel building beside the drawn highway, with its parking lot between them.

10045247.note: The pin sits on the long motel building beside the drawn highway, with its parking lot between them.

10149034.note: The pin sits on the house roof, 10 m from the drawn sand lane, among the houses of the dune community.

10165350.note: The lidar relief shows about a dozen levelled tent pads terraced along the shore under the canopy, and the point sits among them inside OpenStreetMap's outline. The outline also runs about 200 m farther south-west along the shore where no pads show, so it holds extra ground. No road; a boat-in campground. Nothing traced.

10165365.note: The outline holds a wooded point beside a cove of the reservoir with no road, and the point is inside it. Dense leaf canopy hides any sites, so the photo can't confirm the boat-in campground.

10165370.note: The lidar relief shows about 19 levelled tent pads along the shore under the canopy, and OpenStreetMap's outline holds all but two at its east edge; the point sits among them. No road; a boat-in campground. Nothing traced.

10165465.note: The lidar relief shows the drawn spur on a levelled bench running north-west from the trailhead parking loop, with level ground beside it where the photo shows a small structure; OpenStreetMap's outline holds it and the point is inside. The individual pads don't show. Nothing traced.

10165475.note: There's no outline, and the lidar relief around the pin shows only old field rows, a ditch and faint trails, with no levelled tent pads, though the same survey shows them plainly at Handsome Lake and Hopewell. The nearest sign of a campground is OpenStreetMap's restroom on the shore 160 m south, so the pin isn't on the campground. Nothing traced or moved.

10165540.note: The nearest outline is about 800 m away, and the pin is in dense leaf canopy just above the reservoir shore with no road, as a boat-in campground would be. The trees hide any sites, so the photo can't confirm or rule it out.

10168556.note: A small cottage roof with a deck stands just north of the drawn sand track, 35 m northwest of the pin, the only roof in that stretch of dunes; the pin was on open dune grass and now sits on the cottage.

10290014.note: The pin sits on the farmhouse; traced the dirt farm lane from where the drawn road stops past the house to the outbuildings (checked over the photo).

10357061.note: The pin sits on the farmhouse; traced the gravel drive from the drawn road's end down past the house's fence (checked over the photo).
